notes: Historical baseline accessions are categorically excluded from document retrieval.
The complete submission is retained because it contains the filing document blocks and exhibits; selected XBRL assets are also retained separately.
Classification identifies neutral event mechanisms and evidence only. It does not infer direction, sentiment, or expected return.
Primary documents and XBRL assets are limited to 30 MB each; the SEC complete-submission container has a separately bounded 50 MB limit.
The complete package remains capped at 100 MB decoded and raw; any missing required document, unsafe filename, size-limit breach, or malformed package blocks the accession without calculating alpha.
